name: co.fictura/mcp
title: Fictura
description: Paywalls, onboarding, subscription analytics, A/B tests, attribution and errors for mobile apps.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional Fictura MCP key (fk_mcp_...) from Dashboard > Setup > Coding agents (MCP). Leave it out to sign in with your Fictura account (OAuth) instead.

environmentVariables.name: FICTURA_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Fictura MCP key (fk_mcp_...) from Dashboard > Setup > Coding agents (MCP). Leave it out to sign in with your Fictura account in the browser instead. The documentation tools work either way.

environmentVariables.name: FICTURA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Fictura API base URL. Leave unset unless Fictura support asks you to change it.
